The basic Shade fighter's primary weapon is a pair of laser cannons tied to a dedicated power generator and targeting computer. The Shade fighter lacks a slipstream drive, not only to save on weight and cost but also to discourage defection. To reduce costs and increase maneuverability, most Shade variants lack deflector shields; vulnerable to direct hits from enemy starfighters, this further encourages pilots to shoot first and accurately. Shade fighter pilots are considered elite within the Directorate Navy, relying on their quick reflexes and fearlessness to survive multiple tours of duty. Training involves hundreds of flight hours learning to coordinate as a team and intense psychological conditioning to put the accomplishment of their mission above other considerations.
